name: ReuScope
description: Derived records for 'ReuScope: Auditing Data Reuse and Evaluation Sensitivity in Capsule Vision 2024' (NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track): public-file metadata of the Capsule Vision 2024 (CV2024) release, byte-identity, video-prefix, hash and pixel-similarity measurements, ordered training and evaluation lists, seed-level metric records and saved model probabilities. No images or model weights are included.
citeAs: @inproceedings{choi2026reuscope, title={ReuScope: Auditing Data Reuse and Evaluation Sensitivity in Capsule Vision 2024}, author={Choi, Eunseob and Kim, Kyeonghun and Lee, Hyuk-Jae and Kim, Nam-Joon}, booktitle={Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems}, year={2026}, note={Evaluations and Datasets Track}}

affiliation.name: Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology

prov:wasDerivedFrom.name: Training and Validation Dataset of Capsule Vision 2024 Challenge, v3
Testing Dataset of Capsule Vision 2024 Challenge, v4

rai:dataCollection: Derived from the public CV2024 training/validation (v3) and official-test (v4) releases and from Kvasir-Capsule. No new images were collected and no human annotation was performed.
rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary use of public datasets: derived metadata, measurements, metric records and model outputs.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Labels and sources are those released with CV2024; nothing is re-annotated. Similarity fields are computed automatically: SHA-256 byte identity, 64-bit pHash and dHash, 96x96 grayscale NCC and SSIM.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Rows keep workbook order and repeated occurrences. The hash screen flags a row when its independent minimum pHash and dHash distances to the Kvasir-Capsule reference are both at most 6. Training and evaluation lists are released in the exact order read by the reported runs; predictions are epoch-ten softmax probabilities.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Maintained in the GitHub repository by the authors; replay.py and recompute.py check the released files against the reported values. Corrections are announced in the repository.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The underlying CV2024 and Kvasir-Capsule frames are de-identified capsule-endoscopy images and should be treated as sensitive health data. This release adds no patient identifiers; filenames expose only the file- and video-level grouping already present in the source releases.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Supports interpretation of benchmark scores by separating data reuse from evaluation sensitivity. The derived views are diagnostics, not a replacement leaderboard, and release anomalies should not be read as misconduct.
rai:dataBiases: KVASIR contributes 71.8% of public validation rows; SEE-AI dominates the other sources, KID and AIIMS are small, and AIIMS covers only Ulcer and Worms. Report per-source results alongside pooled results.
rai:dataUseCases: Reproducing and extending the paper's analyses; evaluating fixed models on the original and diagnostic validation views. Not a patient-held-out, clinical or official-test benchmark.
rai:dataLimitations: Patient and examination identifiers are unavailable, so patient-level overlap cannot be assessed. Hash and pixel screens are not calibrated duplicate detectors. Local-removal lists were designed with access to outcomes.
rai:dataReleaseTimeline: Released with the NeurIPS 2026 camera-ready version (October 2026).
rai:dataReleaseAccess: Open access without registration. Images are not redistributed; obtain them from the CV2024 and Kvasir-Capsule providers under their terms, including the stated research-use conditions.
rai:dataReleaseAuthority: Eunseob Choi, Kyeonghun Kim, Hyuk-Jae Lee and Nam-Joon Kim.
